title: F1 LIST NAMES MOVED KEYS
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: v25.71 promised the F1 full controls list prints the keys as set, and v26.52 made Caps Lock, the HUD size pair, the zoom pair and 0 movable, but the list kept HOLD Q, CAPS, NUM + -, - = and 0 after CHANGE KEYS moved them. Proven in headless Chromium: with Q on K, Caps Lock on L, = on J, Num + on U and 0 on Y, the drawn rows still read HOLD Q, CAPS, NUM + -, - = and 0 while the Q row read K. Those rows now look up the keys as set; a row whose keys are all where they were reads its own text, so nothing changes by default.
now: The F1 full controls list names the keys you moved for the item wheel hold, walk, zoom, HUD size and zoom reset.
